Rosehold — Castle Runbook

Start: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.13d197135b66ddb3]{session12 prep} ends the Scorchwoods and brings the party to the muster. This runbook then stays open for as many sessions as the castle takes. At the table: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.168a20ce123acb41]{rosehold tracker} · @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cde61798bfdf1c71]{Rosehold} (six level notes) · rosehold asset list Tables: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.a1d4390573d3737d]{Ally Calls} · @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cdb134b8dd87d595]{Rosehold Wrinkles} · @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.1e4073f222b2931e]{Rosehold Whispers} · @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.f4b0b12b4e9ee480]{Rosehold Treasures} Source: campaign original. The core book gives only the Evil Queen's stat line and two minions; everything else here is built on printed stat lines and the companion module's castle roster.

1. The shape of it

Six levels, about thirty keyed rooms, three ways in, and one question at the top. The party arrives at level 4 with everything it has collected since Willowbrook, and with every friend it has made camped at the bottom of the road.

Level Note What it is for Play time
0 @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cf5d4639928d11ad]{00 The Thornwall} Muster, the Barrier set piece, the first Echo 60–75 min
1 @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.3425a0f468cbc304]{01 The Outer Ward} Guards, hounds, ravens, the second Echo 20–100 min
2 @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.d3cdccc26a359528]{02 The Hall of the Rose} The reveal: the Society was hers. Third Echo. A warm room 75–90 min
−1 @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.c10765eb089ed929]{03 The Undercroft} Optional. Prisoners, the vault, the Well 75–100 min
3 @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.b21fef9084bc3b6e]{04 The Galleries} The mirror, Ulrik, the journal, fourth Echo. A warm room 90–110 min
4 @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.db73690eb40eebe9]{05 The Frozen Spire} Damon, then Morwenna a whole session

2. Session plan

Session 12 is the camp fight, the rescue and the muster (@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.13d197135b66ddb3]{session12 prep}). After that:

Plan Session 13 Session 14 Session 15 Session 16
Four sessions (everything) Level 0 + Level 1 Level 2 + Undercroft Level 3 Level 4 + epilogue
Three sessions (recommended) Level 0 + Level 1 Level 2 + either Undercroft or half of Level 3 Rest of Level 3 + Level 4 —
Two sessions (fast) Level 0, straight through B1 to Level 2 Level 3 (E1, E3, E4 only) + Level 4 — —

To shorten: Bannik's tunnel or Puca's catapult skips most of Level 1. The Undercroft is wholly optional. On Level 3, only E4 (the journal) is needed for the ending. To lengthen: run every Echo as a full scene, let the players explore the Undercroft, and give each Ally Call its moment.

Each castle session should end in a warm room or at a door: the Kitchens, the Luminaries' Rooms, the Oath Door, the foot of the Stair of Vows.

3. The Cold

One track for the whole castle, 0 to 8, kept on @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.168a20ce123acb41]{rosehold tracker}. It is the Queen's attention and the curse's grip together. Tell the players it exists and say the cost before they choose.

Change Trigger
+1 A Wrinkle (d4 on every Spend Time; a 1 means roll @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cdb134b8dd87d595]{Rosehold Wrinkles})
+1 A loud fight in the open, a forced door, a triggered trap
+1 A glass raven escapes
+2 A Rest inside the walls (warm rooms only)
−1 An Echo is freed (not destroyed)
−1 The Raven Tower flock is destroyed (once)
−2 The Frostbind Well is purified
The Cold What changes
0–1 The castle is asleep. Patrols as written.
2–3 She notices. Patrols double. Morwenna begins to speak (@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.1e4073f222b2931e]{Rosehold Whispers}) whenever the Cold rises.
4–5 She prepares. Gargoyles wake on the Grand Stair. Two Sentinels join her in the throne room. Wisps appear in any room where a Heart Die is spent.
6–7 The Barrier regrows. The muster outside is cut off and fighting. No further Ally Calls can be made until the Cold drops below 6. Amy, if outside, is in danger.
8 She comes down. Morwenna leaves the throne and meets the party wherever they are, with Damon. The finale happens there, without the throne's protection for her, and without the party's preparation.

Floor 0. The Cold does not reset between sessions.

4. Allies

Everyone the party has helped is at the muster (A1). Rules and the full list: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.a1d4390573d3737d]{Ally Calls}. Two picks per PC; Amy and Aurelius are free.

  • Amy comes inside if the party wants her. HP 6, SAVE 12, Armor 0. She is brave, useless in a fight, and the single best tool in the throne room (d8 friendship damage a round). Scamp rides on whoever she trusts most. If the players would rather not escort her, she waits with Aurelius and arrives at the Rose Window on Mari Lwyd, or on the unicorn's light, at the worst possible moment.

  • Aurelius cannot enter: the stairs, and the thorns. He holds the breach. Once, at any time, any hero may call on him through their pin: all Heart Dice restored to everyone (his full-power trait).

  • The Society. Daisy and about forty princesses hold the road. She is the players' window on the PPS: let her be shaken when the rose over the gate is uncovered, and let her ask them afterwards what was inside.

Promotions. At the muster, before the wall, Daisy raises all three PCs from Initiate to Field Operative: they may give orders to the Society's people on the mountain. If Rosehold is taken, the surviving Luminaries offer Knight-Protector. If Morwenna is saved, there is a fifth chair, and it is hers to give.

5. Level 4 at this table

Apply after Amy is restored (session 12). From the core book, p. 31, each PC gains: the level 4 Gift ability, +1 Gift Die (4 GD), +d4 max HP, +1 Heart Die, and Virtue Deepens (roll d20 against each Virtue in order; higher than the Virtue raises it by one). Level 4 is the cap.

PC Level 4 ability Rulings to make before the castle
Filly Wild Form: become an animal she has seen, for [DICE]×10 minutes, with [SUM] HP. At 0 HP she reverts and is Wounded. Agree the list. Seen in play: giant cicada, jaguar, lioness, bear, billy goat, giant spider, serpent, wolfhound-sized crystal wolf, squirrel, badger, goldfish, mule, unicorn (GM call), dragon (GM call). Suggested: yes to the dragon, at [SUM] HP, with a bite (d12) and no breath; it is the finale.
Vega Summon: a small earth elemental with [SUM] HP, Virtues equal to his WITS, attacks within a Stone's Throw for d6, lasts [DICE] hours. Also: immune to earth damage. Decide what counts as earth: mudlings and the vats (yes), Damon (recommended yes), falling masonry (yes), ice (no).
Marigold True Love's Kiss: roll all four Gift Dice; end a deadly Curse, Trauma or enchanted sleep. Once per individual, ever. It is the rules-as-written key to saving Morwenna. Four dice make a Mishap likely; let it happen and let it be worth it.

What level 4 does to the opposition: a four-die Blast or Storm averages 14 damage (7 on a SAVE), and Smooch calms anything with HP at or under [SUM] with no SAVE. Every printed stat line in the castle falls to one full-power Gift. That is fine for the castle's rank and file. Morwenna is the exception: by GM ruling she is much harder than the book (30 HP, two actions a round, unkillable while a Vow Pillar stands; then a 45–65 HP second phase that takes no damage on a passed SAVE). Her numbers and dials are in @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.db73690eb40eebe9]{05 The Frozen Spire}. The rest of the castle's difficulty is attrition (Gift Dice do not come back without a Rest, and a Rest costs +2 Cold), things Gifts do not solve (Echoes, mirrors, doors, the Well), and the last room, where the only damage that gets the good ending cannot be rolled on a Gift Die.

6. The four whispers and the two endings

The save-her ending needs the party to understand what Morwenna needed. Each freed Echo gives one whisper; the journal counts as two.

Whisper From
"She never once asked us to leave. We left." Hilde, A4
"The cold is not her. It is a thing that sits where her heart was. Pull it out by the root." Aethelgard, B4
"She could still hear me. She told me so, the last night. She said it hurt." Lirael, C3
"There was never a cure to find out there. It was always going to be someone staying." Wren, E2

  • Each freed Echo also removes one Vow Pillar from the throne room and 5 HP from the second phase. Freeing all four is the difference between a hard fight and a nearly unwinnable one.

  • All four held: Marigold's True Love's Kiss ends the curse outright. Without Marigold, friendship damage works at double value.

  • Some held: each one, quoted to her, costs the Frost-Crowned a spell. The ending must be earned on friendship damage.

  • None held: the fight is a fight. It can still end in mercy if the last blow is a Heart Die and a memory.

Neither ending is the wrong one. The players said in session 11 that they intend to kill a dragon to keep their loot; this table may well choose the sword. Play Aurelius's grief honestly and give them their victory.

7. Cameos and where they land

Who Where From
Daisy, Nim, Billy Goat, Mama Bear, pixies, Nettie, Grumbold, Bannik, Mari Lwyd, Puca, Pippin, Raphael's party, the wolves, Morgana A1 muster, then as @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.a1d4390573d3737d]{Ally Calls} Sessions 1–11
The two ents Vega woke A2, as the reason the Awakened Trees listen to him Session 6
Bramble, an old wolfhound B2 New; for Filly
The "ghoul" guard B5 Sessions 4–5
The goblins who fled the Queen C4 Session 3's journal
Villum C3, or any Picnic Session 7's bargain
Bran the Forager D2 Session 8's note; the party has his fishing pole
Lady Vespera D2 Sessions 2, 5; never confronted
Mortar, Grumbold's cousin D3 Session 9's sneezing cure
Sir Dain's words D4 Session 11
The Baron's relics; a second control orb D5 Sessions 4, 8
Aethelgard, whose staff Marigold carries B4 Session 8's whisper and "Guardian"
Lirael of Silverspire, Daisy's great-aunt C3 Daisy
Magus Ulrik; Tifa's notebook E3 Named in session 10, never met
Sir Damon F2 Tawny's nightmare, session 10

Items that finally matter: silver everything (wisps, Echoes, wights, the mirror, the Construct); the silver pitcher (the mirror wants silver and blunt); Corruption Cures (the ooze, Mortar, the Well); the Golden Unicorn Tear (the Well); Death Knell (the crypt); Spectacles of Discernment (the true mirror, "the girl," Ulrik's disguise, gargoyles); the iron horseshoe; Liquid Courage (the Well, Damon); Dewdrop Elixir (any patrol); Ethereal Draught (any sealed door); Mari Lwyd's Teeth; Amulet of the Forest Guardian (Amy at the Barrier); the Rosewood Crown, if they still have it (Back to Bed on Sentinels and wights); Vein-Breaker (the Construct, gargoyles, Damon).

8. Epilogue menu

Run whichever the table has earned. Ten minutes each, at most.

  • The thaw. The frozen household in the court wakes. The ice horses shake themselves. Skillet's goblins ask if they still have jobs.

  • The Society. Daisy climbs the Stair of Vows herself and stands in the great hall for a long time. The fourth line of the oath is cut back into the door.

  • Morwenna, if saved. Old, powerless, and entirely herself. She does not ask to be forgiven. She asks what happened to each of the four, and the party can tell her. What becomes of her (trial, exile, a chair at the table, a room with the door left open) is the players' decision.

  • Morwenna, if slain. Aurelius carries her down the mountain himself. The Society buries its founder under her own rose.

  • Filly. Morgana Twinkleberry, in person, with an opinion about imposter syndrome and a list of every animal Filly has ever rescued, read aloud.

  • Vega. The deed in the library. Rosehold was held in trust "for the instruction of those who come after." The Royal College of Geological Studies needs a founder, and a troll has opinions about the syllabus.

  • Marigold. Aethelgard's Sanctum needs a keeper. So does the question of what she ran from, and whether, with these two beside her, it is time to go back and look at it.

  • Amy. Honorary knighthoods from Drakenshire, as the book promises, and a standing invitation to bring the lioness.

  • Tawny. Gets the swan from the banquet.
